welcome: Your engineering work, in one place.
welcomeText: Create an AbqJobPilot Project, or open an existing one to view its tasks and evidence.
external: An .inp or .cae file is an engineering input, not an AbqJobPilot Project. External files stay in their original location.
startGuide: Create → start service explicitly → connect your client
readScope: Recorded evidence · successive bounded reads, not one atomic snapshot
stale: Connection lost. Values below are from the last successful read; the task state has not been changed.
scopeNote: A closed managed scope does not prove Solver success or that every external process has exited.
noSubmit: Task preparation and approval use the trusted workflow. This view cannot approve or submit a Solver job.
emptyProject: Your project is ready. No runs yet.
emptyGuide: Start its service when you are ready, then connect a client. Creating a project grants no execution permission.
classicNote: Classic Project · separate queue and history · no migration
classicSelect: Select a Classic Project to use this workspace. Execution Monitor remains available in the navigation.
newDetail: Abaqus is the only available type. This does not enable arbitrary Abaqus analyses or grant execution permission.
ownership: Project owns its metadata and execution history. No external engineering files will be copied.
initial: Initial state: PAUSED · 0 grants · 0 runs · service not started
stopNote: Stop requires the correct owner and safe idle conditions. Active, unknown or retained resources can block it. No force stop is offered.
closeNote: Closing this window disconnects the GUI. It does not stop the service or a running job.
pythonText: Python clients use the same Project service. An exact trusted Grant is required for execution; the GUI need not stay open.
mcpText: Current MCP: five Classic read-only / preview tools. No execution, approval or service-control tools.
secretText: Local user credentials remain private. Connection secrets are never shown or copied here.
languageNote: Applies to this user’s interface only. Project data, API codes and original evidence remain unchanged.
coverage: Design text translated · production translation pending
reviewPending: French and German require native-language review before release.
layoutNote: Drag dividers to resize. Display preferences are separate from Project and execution settings.
noResult: No completed result for the selected run
resultNote: Validation belongs to this Run and its recorded artifacts. File presence alone is not a pass.
error.PROJECT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: Project identity does not match. Select the correct Project; no service was changed.
error.COMMUNICATION_UNKNOWN: The service could not be reached. Last successful read: {time}. Reconnect to check its state.
error.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Unsupported Project format. Opening did not initialize, repair or migrate it.
error.generic: Operation unavailable ({code}). No automatic retry. Check the recorded reason before continuing.
noLogs: No run selected · logs appear here after selection
classicSelected: Classic Project selected for this workspace only. Use Runs to return to the Project service monitor.
